chapter_title: Lab: Synthetic Instruction Set with Filter+Dedup+Verify
course_outline_concepts: Generate ~5K instructions with Self-Instruct-style bootstrap + Evol-Instruct depth operators
Apply three filters in sequence: format-validity, IFD difficulty, MinHash dedup — report survival-rate per stage
Add a verifier gate for any reasoning/tool-calling subset (exact-match, execution, or LLM-judge)
Train a small (~1B) SFT on your set vs on a matched-size LIMA-filtered subset; ablate each filter stage
Deliverable: synthetic-set-memo.md with survival tables, quality spot-check, and one failure-mode you discovered
Resource-constrained path: generate 1K instructions instead of 5K; train ~500M model for SFT; ablate only the two filters most novel to the learner.

sources.what_to_extract: Four-step pipeline (seed, instruction gen, instance gen, filter); 175-seed template; ROUGE-L > 0.7 diversity filter; classification-vs-non-classification branching; 52K/82K accepted counts.

Five In-Depth operators (add-constraints, deepening, concretizing, increased-reasoning-steps, complicate-input) + one In-Breadth; elimination rules (same-or-similar, refusal markers, punctuation-only, verbatim-copy); 4 rounds → ~250K.
IFD pipeline (warm-up 1K/1epoch → score → top-K); top 10% beats full set; self-referential property.
Exact IFD formula: PPL(a|q) / PPL(a); interpretation bands (<1, ≈1, >1); right-padding; same tokenizer/system prompt rule.
Shingles → MinHash signature → LSH bucket → exact check; approximate Jaccard resemblance.
NearDup parameters (5-gram shingles, 9000 signatures, b=20 bands × r=450 rows, ≈0.8 Jaccard threshold); 3% of C4 is near-duplicate; memorization drops 10× post-dedup.
3-layer verifier (JSON-schema format → sandboxed execution with 5s timeout → LLM-judge Yes/No); ablation: –6%/-11%/-18% per layer removed.
1K handcurated beats 52K Alpaca on head-to-head; diversity > raw count; StackExchange + wikiHow + Reddit + hand-written mix; LR lowered through epochs.
Single-axis ChatGPT rubric (0–5, keep ≥4.5); 9K from 52K; 5.7× speedup; threshold sensitivity (4.5 > 4.0).
Complexity × Quality × Diversity framework; score-first greedy selector with embedding-distance threshold; 6K–10K sweet spot.
Ablation discipline: change one thing at a time, predict outcome before running; 'overfit one batch' SFT sanity; ordered-regularizer list.

hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Every code sketch must have real function signatures (not pseudocode)
Quote the attested parameter values from raw-data sources; label inferred defaults when not attested
Capstone rule: the chapter must close the synthetic track — it integrates Self-Instruct (ch-19), Evol-Instruct (ch-20), IFD (ch-23), MinHash (ch-25), LIMA (ch-22), APIGen (ch-27)
